about: Shared test vectors for the hash chain (SEC-02, STF-09) and posted-document reversal (SEC-03). Every implementation (server/src/lib/hash-chain.js, license/hash-chain.js, android-native core/audit) must pass all of them. Never edit v1; make hashchain-v2.json for a new format.

rules.canonicalJson: RFC 8785 (JCS) subset: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code units; no whitespace; strings escaped exactly like ECMAScript JSON.stringify (\" \\ \b \f \n \r \t, other chars below U+0020 as \u00xx lowercase, everything else literal); lone surrogates are rejected (lone_surrogate); numbers must be integers with |n| <= 2^53-1 (money always in minor units) else not_integer; -0 is written 0; JS-only undefined object properties are omitted.
rules.hash: lowercase hex of SHA-256( ASCII(prevHash) || UTF-8(canonicalJson(doc)) ); prevHash is 64 lowercase hex chars
rules.link: entries[0].prevHash == genesis; entries[i].prevHash == entries[i-1].hash; entries[i].seq (when present) == i+1; the first failure wins, checked per entry in the order seq_gap, prev_mismatch, bad_doc, hash_mismatch
rules.reversal: only status=posted documents; never a document that has reverses; never twice; opts id/reason/by non-empty strings, no >= 1 integer, postedAt integer (bad_opts); the whole document must be canonical-valid; then integer values of ["qty","amount","total","subtotal","discount","tax","paid","change"] are negated at top level and inside every object of ["lines","payments"] (null kept, non-integer -> not_integer); unitPrice is kept; then id, no, postedAt, status=posted, reverses=<original id>, reason, by are set.
rules.errorOrder: not_posted, is_reversal, already_reversed, bad_opts, canonical errors, not_integer from negation

canonical.name: key order is UTF-16 code units

guard.name: posted, identical in another key order
